name: 10 Minute Mail
summary: Auto-expiring disposable email inbox, no signup.
detail: Generates a temporary email address that lives for 10 minutes. Receive emails in real time in the browser. Extend in 10-minute increments. No account or personal info required.
howTo: Navigate to 10minutemail.com
Copy the auto-generated address
proTip: Refresh the page to check for new messages — the inbox is live but doesn't auto-refresh on all browsers.

name: AnonAddy
summary: Open-source email aliasing — forward to real inbox without exposure.
detail: Create unique email aliases per service. All replies route through the alias; the sender never sees your real address. Open-source and self-hostable for full operational control.
howTo: Create an account with your real email (or self-host)
Generate a new alias for each target service
proTip: Self-host the open-source version on a VPS for zero trust in a third party.

name: SimpleLogin
summary: Email alias service — now part of Proton ecosystem.
detail: Create unlimited email aliases that forward to your real inbox. Supports reply-via-alias so the sender never sees your real address. Integrates with Proton Mail.
howTo: Sign up at simplelogin.io or use Proton account
Create a new alias per investigation or registration

name: MailDrop
summary: Zero-signup temp inbox — just pick any username.
detail: No account needed. Navigate to maildrop.cc, pick any inbox name, and use that address. Anyone can read the same inbox if they know the name — treat as public.
howTo: Go to maildrop.cc
Type any username into the inbox field
proTip: These inboxes are public — never use for sensitive replies. Good for one-way verification codes only.

name: Globfone Send Text
summary: Send a free anonymous SMS to any mobile number.
detail: Send a text message without revealing your real number. Messages appear as 'Unknown' or from a carrier-assigned number. 140 character limit on free tier. No account required.
howTo: Navigate to globfone.com/send-text
Enter the destination number with country code

name: Receive SMS Online (hs3x)
summary: Public shared phone numbers that receive SMS — no SIM needed.
detail: Browse a list of real phone numbers. Use one as a verification number. Messages are visible to anyone viewing the page — strictly public. Good for one-time verification codes.
howTo: Browse the number list and pick a country-appropriate number
Use that number for the SMS verification step
proTip: These numbers are shared publicly. Never use for anything that must stay private.

name: FaxZero
summary: Send up to 5 free faxes/day to any US or Canada number.
detail: Upload a PDF or document and send it as a fax without a fax machine. Sender number appears as FaxZero's number. Confirmation email on delivery. 5 free faxes per day, 3 pages each.
howTo: Navigate to faxzero.com
Enter sender name and recipient fax number

name: Twilio
summary: Programmable SMS/voice API — buy numbers, automate at scale.
detail: Purchase real phone numbers in dozens of countries. Send and receive SMS/calls via REST API or SDKs. Used for building custom OSINT collection tools, alert bots, and anonymous communication pipelines.
howTo: Create an account and verify a real phone number
Purchase a phone number from the console (~$1/month)
proTip: Twilio numbers can receive SMS from any carrier. Great for building a persistent covert inbox on a custom number.

name: Amazon SNS
summary: AWS Simple Notification Service — programmatic SMS at scale.
detail: AWS service for sending SMS messages to any number worldwide. Very low cost, high deliverability. Requires AWS account. Best for automation rather than manual use.
howTo: Create an AWS account and navigate to SNS in the console
Select 'Text messaging (SMS)' from the left panel
